entities.summary: Frank Hördler is a German professional ice hockey defenceman who currently plays for VER Selb in the DEL2. He previously played the entirety of his professional career with Eisbären Berlin in the Deutsche Eishockey Liga, spending 20 seasons with the club in the DEL.
